observations: Photo 0 shows an industrial machine with a blue metal housing on casters.
Front cabinet doors are open, revealing a control panel with buttons and a small screen.
Upper section has a mechanical assembly with what appears to be mold/clamping components typical of blow molding equipment.
A small logo/sticker is visible on the control panel but text is too small/blurry to read.
No visible nameplate, serial number, capacity rating, or cavity count is legible anywhere in the frame.
Background shows a warehouse/yard setting with other machinery and trucks, consistent with a dealer or industrial lot.
Seller's new message is text only, no new photo or video provided.

identity.kind: automatic PET plastic bottle blow molding machine

claims.evidence: Seller asserts personal testing yesterday, but no video, photo of a running cycle, or output sample was provided; a verbal claim cannot be confirmed remotely.
No service record, invoice, or maintenance photo provided, even after follow-up.
Internal molds, heating elements, compressor/air lines still not visible or itemized.
No manufacturer nameplate, serial number, or certificate visible in photo 0 or supplied afterward.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or complete a molding cycle.
risks.proof: Video clip of machine running a full blow-molding cycle producing a bottle.

risks.risk: Mold cavities, heating bands, or control board may be missing or damaged (not visible with doors mostly closed on top section).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of mold cavities, heater bands, and open top compartment.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming missing/damaged tooling, lowering value

risks.risk: Unknown capacity/output rate and bottle size range, which heavily affects industrial value.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the nameplate/specification sticker showing model, voltage, output (bottles/hour), and bottle size range.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced without this; treated as unspecified low-capacity unit

risks.risk: Compressor, chiller, or auxiliary equipment needed to operate may not be included.
risks.proof: Full-set photo showing compressor and auxiliary units included in the sale.
risks.if_unproven: priced as machine only, without auxiliaries

risks.risk: Claimed 'recent service' and 'tested myself' cannot be confirmed, so hidden wear or electrical faults may exist.
risks.proof: Dated service receipt or video showing diagnostic/test run.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified condition, same as not serviced

proof_requests: Clear photo of the manufacturer's nameplate/serial number/specification sticker.
Video of the machine running a full cycle producing a finished bottle.
Photos of the open top compartment showing mold cavities and heating elements.
Photo/list of all included auxiliary equipment (compressor, chiller, molds).
Any service/maintenance receipt with date and technician details.
response.reason: A verbal reassurance with no new photo or video does not change the evidence; the nameplate, specs, and a working test are still unseen, so pricing cannot proceed past the original proof request.
